# Nexus Command Lab

> Tactical AI laboratory for Heroes of the Storm: draft intelligence, replay forensics, map mastery, and multi-agent analysis. Headless API + React UI; agents should prefer the API.

This site is agent-ready: use the **API** for data and actions. The UI is for humans. Base URL for API is the same origin (e.g. `/api`). For machine-readable endpoint list, GET `/api/discovery`. 

**Nexus Comm-Link (MCP)**: For IDE-based agents (Cursor, Windsurf, etc.), run the MCP server at `scripts/nexus_mcp_server.py`. It exposes the Nexus core as standard tools (e.g. `nexus_match_history`, `nexus_hero_dossier`, `nexus_intel_query`).

- **Dual-interface**: Visual layer (React) and structured JSON API (Flask).
- **Predictable APIs**: All agent actions map to REST endpoints; see ## API and `/api/discovery`.

## API

- [GET /api/health](/api/health): Service health and version
- [GET /api/discovery](/api/discovery): Machine-readable list of endpoints (for agents)
- [GET /api/match_history](/api/match_history): Match history archives
- [POST /api/upload_replay](/api/upload_replay): Ingest a .StormReplay file
- [POST /api/analyze_replay](/api/analyze_replay): Trigger deep forensic analysis
- [POST /api/chat](/api/chat): Consult Nexus (natural language)
- [GET /api/advice/stats](/api/advice/stats): Advice/telemetry stats
- [GET /api/telemetry/temporal](/api/telemetry/temporal): Temporal telemetry
- [GET /api/nexus/agents](/api/nexus/agents): List AI specialized agents
- [POST /api/nexus/ask](/api/nexus/ask): Dispatch multi-agent query (Agentic Brain)
- [GET /api/player_interactions](/api/player_interactions): Social Intelligence data
- [GET /api/player_network](/api/player_network): Player network graph
- [POST /api/extract_stats_from_screenshot](/api/extract_stats_from_screenshot): Screen-space stats extraction
- [GET /api/nexus_config](/api/nexus_config): Master roster constraints & strategy manifest
- [GET /api/strategies](/api/strategies): Detailed map strategies
- [GET /api/player_profile](/api/player_profile): Active operator profile
- [GET /api/system/health](/api/system/health): Integrated system health
- [GET /api/watcher/status](/api/watcher/status): Replay watcher connectivity
- [GET /api/data_sources/status](/api/data_sources/status): Data source synchronization status
